title: KTP Hand-Back
description: The typed destination of an adverse stop inside a managed relation (specifications/hand-back.md, Section 4). Registered at grant, resolved at stop. A Revoked or Exceeded clearance without a valid hand-back is a protocol error, never a clearance.

action.description: The action identifier the stop answers.

reason.description: The reason class. Covers the denial taxonomy of KTP-ENFORCE so that no denial class lacks a typed exit.

endpoint.description: The accountable human endpoint of the subject's Delegator, from the registered template; for a person subject, the person.

ack_sla_seconds.description: The consequence-scaled acknowledgment ceiling, from the deployment profile.

ref.description: A contest path owned independently of the agent, the measurer and the operator; the sovereign authority and its protocol; or the registry consulted.

repair.description: The reconciliation route KTP-RELATIONAL publishes for the subject; the record that closes a breach is KTP-REPAIR's.

reissue_not_before.description: The earliest reissue, from the lease structure (Section 7).

sealed_to.description: The recipient endpoint key the bundle is sealed to; the transporting agent cannot read it.

delivery.description: Delivery is a runtime obligation: a parked hand-back retries on the declared schedule; the denial holds throughout.
